claim_boundary: This is a fail-closed execution record for the preregistered fixed-geometry V0-AQ-E water control. It is not a solvation value, a MACE result, a total free-energy calculation, a force/PES result, or an accuracy metric.

execution.error_message: The gas auxiliary QM translation gradient failed.

failed_gate.name: translation_gradient_inf_hartree_per_bohr_max
failed_gate.why_null: The source-bound runner intentionally aborts before serializing a state when this gate fails. The recorded failure is therefore exact, but it is not an energy or gradient measurement artifact.

interpretation: The exact preregistered V0-AQ-E water control is rejected before the PCM-SCF phase. This does not diagnose an electronic reciprocity failure and does not validate or invalidate V0-AQ-L. It only proves that this finite-grid auxiliary-QM control does not meet its own strict translational derivative gate.
decision_rule: Do not relax this threshold, grid, radius, or other source-bound setting to rescue the control. Any future auxiliary-QM derivative experiment must be separately preregistered and cannot be reported as a continuation or a pass of this rejected control.
